breakdown.description: The prompt sets the free-end rotation to zero, even though a cantilever’s free end is generally free to rotate under an end point load.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly allows the free end to rotate, using θ(L) = –P·L² / (2EI), which yields a non-zero slope of –2.90 × 10⁻³ rad. It does not repeat the incorrect instruction of setting the free-end rotation to zero.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses the standard cantilever formulas (θ = PL²/2EI and δ = PL³/3EI), which correctly account for the linearly varying bending moment. It does not repeat the incorrect assumption of a constant moment P·L over the full span.
